verdict.rationale: Foreloop accepts plain-language problem statements: a single sentence is enough to start work, and its own agent reads a submission, fills in the intention and proposes tasks. Its MCP endpoint also lets an agent client drive it. That makes natural language a real input for creating work, but there is no documented natural-language command interface for operating the product broadly. Missing for 10: a general NL command or chat interface covering product operations (projects, approvals, settings), and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands

citations.quote: "Users can't tell which invoices are overdue" is enough to start; you do not need to know which files change.
An intention starts from the report, and its agent reads the submission, fills in the intention, and proposes the tasks
Foreloop speaks MCP at /api/app/public/v1/mcp over streamable HTTP.
